skiff.description: Skiff is an Android app that lets you send links, movies, and TV shows from your phone to Android TV and Google TV. Share supported links, search for titles by name, and open content directly in compatible TV apps such as Nuvio and Stremio. It also includes a built-in TV remote with navigation, playback controls, and keyboard input. Connect using your TV's pairing code, with optional USB debugging for advanced features.
